from PIL import Image,ImageDraw,ImageFont
import os, numpy as np, subprocess,sys,concurrent.futures
os.chdir('/work')
video='/input/input/tutorial.mp4'
def frame(t):
 p=f'/work/assets/{t:g}.jpg'
 if not os.path.exists(p):subprocess.run(['ffmpeg','-v','error','-ss',str(t),'-threads','2','-i',video,'-frames:v','1','-q:v','3','-threads','1','-y',p],check=True)
 return p
def montage(times,path,box=(1380,0,1920,1080),w=210,h=235,n=6):
 with concurrent.futures.ThreadPoolExecutor(5) as e: paths=list(e.map(frame,times))
 o=Image.new('RGB',(w*n,(h+20)*((len(times)+n-1)//n)),'#e8eef0'); d=ImageDraw.Draw(o)
 for k,(t,p) in enumerate(zip(times,paths)):
  a=Image.open(p).crop(box); a.thumbnail((w-2,h)); x=k%n*w;y=k//n*(h+20); o.paste(a,(x+(w-a.width)//2,y));d.text((x+5,y+h+3),f'{t:g}  {int(t)//60:02}:{t%60:04.1f}',fill='black')
 o.save(path,quality=93)
if __name__=='__main__':
 mode=sys.argv[1]; times=list(map(float,sys.argv[3:])); cfg={'d':((1380,0,1920,1080),210,340,7),'p':((0,0,1380,1080),294,230,6),'f':((0,0,1920,1080),435,245,4)}[mode]; montage(times,'/work/'+sys.argv[2]+'.jpg',*cfg)
PY
